name: Lettuce (Loose Leaf)
description: A cool-season crop that grows quickly. Tends to bolt in hot weather.
tips: Plant every 2 weeks for a continuous harvest. Prefers cooler soil and appreciates afternoon shade in summer.

careTasks.name: Begin hardening off seedlings
careTasks.description: Gradually expose seedlings to outdoor conditions over a week to prevent shock.

careTasks.name: Thin direct-sown seedlings
careTasks.description: Remove weaker seedlings to ensure proper spacing (6-8 inches) for healthy growth.

careTasks.name: Start harvesting outer leaves
careTasks.description: Harvest your Lettuce (Loose Leaf) when they reach a mature size and color. Regular harvesting can encourage more production.

careTasks.name: Watering
careTasks.description: Water your Lettuce (Loose Leaf) consistently. Provide about 1-2 inches of water per week, adjusting for rainfall.

name: Spinach
description: A very cold-hardy, cool-season crop. Plant in early spring and fall.
tips: Bolts quickly in heat. Provide afternoon shade to extend the harvest. Can be sown in late summer for a fall crop.

careTasks.name: Thin seedlings
careTasks.description: Remove weaker seedlings to ensure proper spacing (4-6 inches) for healthy growth.

careTasks.name: Begin harvesting outer leaves
careTasks.description: Harvest your Spinach when they reach a mature size and color. Regular harvesting can encourage more production.

careTasks.name: Watering
careTasks.description: Water your Spinach consistently. Provide about 1-2 inches of water per week, adjusting for rainfall.

name: Kale
description: Hardy cool-season green that gets sweeter after a light frost.
tips: Harvest outer leaves to allow the center to keep producing. Very cold tolerant and can often be harvested into winter.

careTasks.name: Begin hardening off seedlings
careTasks.description: Gradually expose seedlings to outdoor conditions over a week to prevent shock.

careTasks.name: Check for cabbage worms
careTasks.description: Inspect leaves for small green caterpillars and their droppings. Remove them by hand or use an appropriate organic pesticide.

careTasks.name: Begin harvesting outer leaves
careTasks.description: Harvest your Kale when they reach a mature size and color. Regular harvesting can encourage more production.

careTasks.name: Watering
careTasks.description: Water your Kale consistently. Provide about 1-2 inches of water per week, adjusting for rainfall.

name: Swiss Chard

tips: Harvest outer leaves regularly to encourage continued growth. Both leaves and stems are edible.

name: Arugula
description: A fast-growing, peppery cool-season green that bolts quickly in heat.
tips: Succession plant every 2 weeks. Harvest leaves when young and tender for mildest flavor.

careTasks.name: Thin seedlings
careTasks.description: Remove weaker seedlings to ensure proper spacing (4-6 inches) for healthy growth.

careTasks.name: Begin harvesting leaves
careTasks.description: Harvest your Arugula when they reach a mature size and color. Regular harvesting can encourage more production.

careTasks.name: Watering
careTasks.description: Water your Arugula consistently. Provide about 1-2 inches of water per week, adjusting for rainfall.
